newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's IBEX-35 closes down 2.31 pct to 5,324.68.
newsitem.headline: Spain's IBEX-35 closes down 2.31 pct to 5,324.68.

text.p: Spain's IBEX-35 index of leading shares closed down 126.06 points, or 2.31 percent on Friday, to 5,324.68 as Wall Street fell, dealers said.
At 1615 GMT, the Dow Jones Industrials had fallen 175.43 points, or 1.12 percent, to 6,679.93.
The IBEX had been down sharply during the day following Wall Street's overnight fall, but extended losses at the end of the day.
